architecture_conclusion.text: V554 should provisionally become a narrow reference-composed bounded structural-affordance layer: V555 may directly reuse original V550 semantic/directionality/position/use authority, V552 structural facts/decomposition, V552J admission/use permission and relevant evidence lineage, while intended completed V553 supplies exact temporal key/observation/relation/limit meaning. V554's likely unique contribution is only downstream mediation-input affordance eligibility/constraint, unresolved requirements, typed limits and optionally governed conflict linkage. It must not recreate pressure, temporal identity, position authority, mediation routes, household/person facts or psyche. Current aggregate-first, interpolated, synthetic-ID/score and hardcoded mediation/slice machinery should not define the binding design.

major_conclusions.text: Rawlsing downstream flow is a governed DAG. V554/V555 may directly reuse earlier governed objects under their original ownership rather than requiring V554 to republish them.

Assuming frozen V553 completion lands materially as designed, exact sparse TEMPORAL_KEY/TEMPORAL_OBSERVATION/TEMPORAL_RELATION/TEMPORAL_LIMIT objects and the exact V554 handoff are V554's temporal authority; country-year aggregate is secondary reversible convenience only.

The strongest residual V554 job is a governed bounded downstream-use affordance: whether an exact structural-temporal condition may function as a later mediation input under specified unresolved structural conditions, without route or actor realization.

Current V554 is aggregate-first, synthesizes weaker identities and scores, creates ungrounded contradiction and slice/mediation classes, and has parallel specialized/thin contracts with duplicated readiness semantics.
Readiness, harmonization, coverage, confidence and file presence cannot replace structural pressure, certified position/directionality authority or explicit downstream permission.

The safe advisory default is no new authoritative V554 numeric seed-strength score absent a named governed formula; V555 can reuse original V552 values, V553 deltas and producer authority/confidence directly.
